title: The unique strict tensor quotient augmentation with prescribed coordinates
statement: For a prime ell, a finite coefficient extension E and any scheme T, there exists exactly one natural transformation from the actual ordinary signed total tensor to the actual completed strict tensor complex whose product coordinates on every pure total tensor are the tensor of the two finite quotient units and whose shifted mapping-cocone coordinate is zero. The normalization predicate is the literal pair of those equations. No geometric, constructibility or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: The tensor-product operation in the proof, specialized to the strict quotient completion augmentation; the representative formula of def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports.

proof.text: The constructed map of lem-pur-strict-tensor-augmentation-construction has the prescribed coordinates by lem-pur-strict-tensor-augmentation-coordinates, and so supplies the witness.

For two normalized maps, compare each product projection in every degree. The pure total tensor generators determine the degree morphisms by the pure-tensor extensionality theorem of lem-pur-strict-tensor-augmentation-coordinates. Product extensionality identifies the first coordinates. The second coordinates are both zero; mapping-cocone extensionality identifies the full components, and natural-transformation extensionality identifies the two maps. Apply this to the constructed witness to establish uniqueness.
